title: Adjacency uniformity implies uniformity
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits. If $C$ is canonical and has logspace-decidable adjacency information, then $C$ is logspace-uniform.
hypotheses_covered: For every gate type, $C$'s type language is in LOGSPACE
